Web Awesome 3.14.0
Source: https://github.com/shoelace-style/webawesome
npm: @awesome.me/webawesome@3.14.0
License: MIT (Fonticons, Inc.) — see LICENSE.md
Pinned: 2026-10-29
Subset: the components imported by /vendor/panel-kit.js and the theme CSS they need.
Icons used by those components are the inlined "system" set (Font Awesome Free, CC BY 4.0).
No CDN requests. Three local patches, all marked in the files:
- chunk.KKI7M5DP.js getIconUrl returns an empty SVG instead of ka-f.fontawesome.com.
- chunk.SLTXS4GR.js decodes data: icon URLs without fetch, so connect-src stays 'self'.
- chunk.L7UUCOPZ.js drawer handleOpenChange only requests close when open is false,
  same as wa-dialog. The published check closed the drawer as soon as it opened.
Components use library="system" (inlined Font Awesome Free icons, CC BY 4.0).
